datasets.name: 2-metre air temperature
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of MERRA-2 monthly air temperature
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-average export; contributing centre is 31.5N, 74.375E (one native cell).
limitations: Temperature is retained in kelvin, without conversion to Celsius.
Reanalysis is not a direct satellite temperature measurement.

datasets.name: Precipitation rate
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of IMERG Final satellite-gauge precipitation
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-averaged monthly series. Source Data Bounding Box records contributing cell centres; individual grid-cell histories are absent.
limitations: The export request specifies the native IMERG precipitation field without a unit override. Units are interpreted as mm/hr from the product documentation; confirm the original request during scientific review.
Each monthly row is a precipitation rate, not a monthly rainfall total. No conversion or annual summation of rates is performed.
Actual supplied coverage ends in September 2025 although the request ends in December 2025; October-December values are not supplied.
The application also converts the original Karachi inch/day export to mm/hr, recording that conversion explicitly; these source values require no conversion.

datasets.name: Direct evaporation from bare soil (energy flux)
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of GLDAS Noah monthly direct evaporation from bare soil
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-averaged monthly series. Source Data Bounding Box records contributing cell centres; individual grid-cell histories are absent.
limitations: ESoil_tavg is a modelled bare-soil evaporation energy flux in W m-2; it is not total evapotranspiration or a water-depth rate.
No energy-to-water conversion is performed. Compare only matching source variables and units.

datasets.name: Soil moisture content (10–40 cm)
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of GLDAS Noah monthly soil moisture
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-averaged monthly series. Source Data Bounding Box records contributing cell centres; individual grid-cell histories are absent.
limitations: Model-derived mass of water per unit area in the 10–40 cm soil layer; not volumetric m3/m3.
Karachi supplies the 0–10 cm layer. Matching units do not make different soil layers directly comparable.

datasets.name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
datasets.source: Supplied MOD13A3 monthly NDVI statistics export, grouped in the Lahore source folder
datasets.spatial_support: Statistics export with contributing Count between 2304 and 2304 per month; pixel coordinates and extraction geometry are not included.
limitations: Lahore is the supplied folder association; extraction geolocation is unverified. Do not interpret this as a verified city-wide NDVI result.
Quality flags, extraction polygon and scale/fill metadata are not supplied.
Exported decimal NDVI values are retained without additional scaling.

datasets.name: Aerosol optical thickness (550 nm)
datasets.source: Supplied NASA Giovanni export of MERRA-2 total aerosol extinction optical thickness
datasets.spatial_support: Giovanni area-average export; contributing centre is 31.5N, 74.375E (one native cell).
limitations: Optical thickness is not ground-level PM2.5 concentration or an air quality index.
MERRA-2 aerosol reanalysis is not a direct measurement of local exposure.
